title: Choose the home page layout
question: Three layouts in the Ash & Cobalt world. Pick the one to build, and use the note to say what to carry over from the others or what feels wrong.

options.label: The Jar
options.thesis: One monumental stoneware jar beside the headline; the six values run in a row below, divided by cobalt brushstrokes.
options.viewport: Headline, paragraph and Ask for help at left; the jar fills the right half; values row along the bottom.
options.risk: The process (what happens when you ask) waits until further down the page.

options.label: The Glaze Run
options.thesis: A wide band of ash glaze running down the jar's shoulder, with the five steps of asking for help right beside the headline.
options.viewport: Glaze band across the top; headline and Ask for help at left with the five-step process at right; the mission statement begins below.
options.risk: The glaze close-up is abstract; without a caption, visitors may not know what they are looking at.

options.label: The Shelf
options.thesis: Six different hand-thrown vessels on one shelf, each standing above one of the six values: no two alike.
options.viewport: Centered headline and two buttons; a wide shelf of six vessels below, with each value labeled under its vessel.
options.risk: The most symbolic option; the vessel-per-value idea needs to read as respect, not decoration.
